title: Tangents, stationary points and optimisation
intro: Read this before the questions on gradients and turning points.

blocks.title: gradient and tangent
blocks.body: The gradient of the curve at $x=a$ is $f'(a)$. The tangent is $y-f(a)=f'(a)(x-a)$.

blocks.title: stationary points
items: If $f''(a)=0$: the test fails, check the sign of $f'$ either side.

blocks.title: the slips
items: Do not stop at $f'(x)=0$: also find the $y$-value if the point is asked for.
A stationary point need not be a maximum or minimum.
